A '''Fallanassi village''' was located on [[Pydyr]] by [[44 ABY]]. The village was located on an island on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], and the village, island, and surrounding area were all protected by illusions in the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]], hiding their visibility to all beings who did not know how to access the White Current&mdash;even other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. However, in 44 ABY, the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] arrived and hid briefly among the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]], until she was found there by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] and the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. Soon after, a [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|battle]] took palce in the village between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and Abeloth, resulting in the defeat of the Sith force and Abeloth fleeing.
